title: Delay Add-on to the Repayment Interest Rate under Network Participation Agreements
content:
**Schedule.** This schedule applies to interest Cascade pays on a repayment of an over-recovery under the Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement, one of the **Network Participation Agreements**. The delay add-on to the repayment interest rate is set by the days from the dispute decision's resolved date to the repayment date:

| Days from the resolved date to the repayment date | Points added to the annual rate |
|---|---|
| More than 90 | 6 |
| More than 45 and at most 90 | 3 |
| 45 or fewer | Nothing |

## Terms

- **The decision** is the agreement's most recent dispute decision, read for its resolved date. Where two decisions share the latest date, the one listed first on the agreement's records is taken.
- **The repayment date** is the date of the agreement's most recent claim payment remittance.
- **Counting days.** The resolved date is not counted; the repayment date is.

The points are percentage points of annual interest, added to the annual rate at which the repayment interest is worked out.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- 45 days from decision to repayment: nothing added. 46 days: 3 points.
- 90 days: 3 points. 91 days: 6 points.
